title: The strength level sheet is never tested on screen
what: Only the level maths and the line's words are tested. No test opens 'What this means', checks the member's level is marked, taps Women and sees the level change, or checks the choice is still there when the sheet opens again. The privacy sentence is not checked either.
expected: A phone test opens the sheet, changes the comparison, sees the level move, reopens and finds the choice kept, and reads the privacy line.
fix_line: Add a phone test of the strength level sheet and its comparison chips

title: Making and joining a superset is only half tested
what: The phone test makes one superset and stops at 'Edit superset'. No test checks both cards carry the badge, that typed sets survive, that joining moves the card next to its group, or the message shown when the workout has only one exercise.
expected: Tests check both cards are marked, typed sets are kept, a joined card moves beside its group, and the one-exercise sheet says how to make a superset.
fix_line: Extend the superset phone test and add the one-exercise sheet case

title: Swapping an exercise in a routine, and a failed swap, are never tested
what: No test swaps an exercise on a routine's page and checks the sets and reps stay; the only test touching that step replaces it with a stand-in. No test shows the no-close-match sheet or the 'Could not swap' message, and none checks sore areas are left out of the choices.
expected: A database test swaps an exercise in a routine and finds the same sets and reps; small tests cover the no-match words, the failed swap keeping the old card, and sore areas.
fix_line: Add a real-database routine swap test and the failure cases

title: The Hevy or Strong pick on the welcome screen is never tested
what: Only the card's sentence and when the card may show are tested. No test picks Hevy on the welcome screen and checks the import opens once after setup, never again, and not after a backup restore. No test taps 'From Strong' and checks the Strong import opens.
expected: A phone test picks an app on the welcome screen and sees its import open once; small tests cover the pick being dropped on a restore and taken back.
fix_line: Add a welcome-pick phone test and the restore case

title: The 'Demo data · Remove' strip is never tested
what: The removal itself is well tested on a real database, but only from Settings. No test checks the strip shows on every tab while the demo is loaded, shows 'Removing...', goes away when the data stops being the demo, or shows 'Could not remove the demo' after a failure.
expected: A phone test loads the demo, sees the strip on each tab, removes it from the strip, and a small test covers the failure message and a single question.
fix_line: Add a phone test that removes the demo from the strip

title: The Gym tab badge and the tab bar over the keyboard are never tested
what: The unread count is tested as data only. No test checks the number on the Gym icon, the '9+' cap, the screen reader words, the new-feature dot, or that the tab bar steps aside when the keyboard opens.
expected: Tests check the badge shows the count and '9+', the dot never shows with a number, and the tab bar hides while typing.
fix_line: Add a badge test and a typing check to a phone flow

title: Old trainer videos after a link is removed or the member changes gym are never tested
what: The link rules are tested, but no test checks a link the trainer removed disappears, or that after leaving gym A its trainer's name and videos are gone for gym B. The 'Couldn't open the video' message is not tested.
expected: Tests check the card goes when the link is removed, no card of gym A shows after joining gym B, and the open-failed message shows.
fix_line: Add tests for a removed link, a gym change and a failed open

title: The workout bar above the tabs is barely tested
what: Only where the bar shows is tested. No test checks its words, the rest countdown matching the workout screen, the 'Editing a workout' state with no clock, the 'Workout paused' state on the bar, or the bar going after the finish.
expected: Tests check the bar's words in each state and that its rest time matches the workout screen.
fix_line: Add tests for each state of the workout bar

title: Photos on the finish screen and in the cloud copy are never tested
what: No test adds a photo on the 'Workout complete' summary or in Edit workout, and no test checks the cloud copy leaves workout photos out. The promise 'Private. They stay on this phone.' rests on code nobody tests.
expected: A test adds a photo from the summary and finds it on the saved workout, and a cloud copy test checks no workout photo is sent.
fix_line: Add a summary-photo test and a cloud-copy check for photos

title: A deleted or unreadable saved workout page is never tested
what: No test opens a workout that was deleted and checks 'Workout not found', opens one whose read fails and checks Try again, or renames one and checks the failure message or the new title. Removing the workout on its page is not tested either.
expected: Tests cover not found, a failed read, a rename and removing the workout on its saved page.
fix_line: Add tests for the saved workout page's error and edit paths

title: The workout calendar and list updates are never tested
what: No test opens the calendar's day list or checks 'No workout that day.' No test checks a renamed or deleted workout updates its card and the range count, or that a chart's workout list holds only that range.
expected: Tests check the calendar day list, the empty day words, and the list after a rename and a delete.
fix_line: Add tests for the calendar and for list updates after edits

title: The AI coach notes switch is never tested, so workouts could reach the AI with it off
what: No test checks the 'AI coach notes' switch: that it shows with the coach, that the built-in note shows with it off, or that no call goes to the AI coach for a workout when it is off.
expected: A test finishes a workout with the switch off and checks no AI call is made and the built-in note shows.
fix_line: Add a test that the AI coach is not called with the switch off

title: The body-weight moves switch on the Last time's numbers page is never tested on screen
what: The rule behind the switch is tested, but no test checks the switch shows only with Same routine, keeps its value after leaving the page, or comes back still on.
expected: A test switches between the two choices and checks the switch hides, shows and keeps its value.
fix_line: Add a settings test for the body-weight switch

title: Easy weeks in Settings is never tested
what: No test checks the Easy weeks card shows only for a followed plan, matches the folder menu, shows the hint with no plan, keeps its value after a failed save, or brings the next easy week back when turned on again.
expected: Tests cover the Easy weeks card with and without a followed plan, a failed save, and off then on.
fix_line: Add tests for the Easy weeks setting

title: The weekly goal page's screen reader words and the widget count are never tested
what: No test checks the screen reader reads '1 workout a week' (not '1 workouts'), that it can change the goal, or that the home-screen widget shows the same count as Up next after a change.
expected: A test reads the page's spoken words and checks the widget count follows the goal.
fix_line: Add spoken-words and widget checks for the weekly goal
